1.consolidated_definition: petroq. Gasoil, aceite pesado, gasóleo. Combustible procedente del petróleo refinado. Poco frecuente. DRAE 2001. Dado que cada vez más competidores (VW, Renault, Peugeot, Citroën, etc) del Mazda6 cuentan con un motor diésel que ronda esa potencia, Mazda ha anunciado que próximamente se ampliará su gama de motores diésel (Keegy Puerto Rico, 05-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Diesel oil, heavy oil, diesel fuel. A refined petroleum product used as a combustible. Rarely encountered. 

Note: DRAE 2001 refers to the Real Academia Española's dictionary from 2001, which is a standard reference for Spanish language and terminology.

Also, Keegy Puerto Rico is likely referring to a local news source or publication in Puerto Rico, but it has been translated as is to preserve the context.
